# ⚠️ BETA Notice

**VRX AntiCheat is currently a BETA plugin.**  
This means the plugin is still being improved, tested and expanded over time.

By purchasing VRX AntiCheat, you will receive access to future updates through the official Veronix Plugins Shop.

Updates, improvements, bug fixes and new features will be provided via:  
https://www.veronix-plugins.de/shop.html

---

# 🛡️ VRX AntiCheat

**VRX AntiCheat** is a professional, modular and highly configurable anti-cheat plugin for Minecraft Paper/Spigot servers.  
It is designed to detect unfair advantages, support staff teams with powerful tools, and provide reliable protection for standalone Minecraft servers.

For Minecraft networks, VRX AntiCheat can optionally be extended with the **VRX AntiCheat BungeeBridge Addon**, which enables network-wide staff alerts across connected BungeeCord servers.

---

## ✨ Key Features

- Advanced movement, combat, interaction, player and packet checks
- Optional **ProtocolLib** support for packet-based detections
- Flexible violation and punishment system
- Staff alerts, debug tools and player history
- Admin GUI for checks, violations and banwave management
- Test mode for safe configuration before going live
- Evidence logging and JSON exports
- SQLite/MySQL storage support
- Discord webhook alerts
- Trust/risk system for smarter violation handling
- Strong false-positive protection
- Optional **BungeeBridge Addon** for network-wide staff alerts

---

## 🧪 Detection Categories

VRX AntiCheat includes checks for common unfair advantages such as:

- Fly, Speed, NoFall, Glide, Phase and AirJump
- Reach, AutoClicker, HitBox, MultiAura and Aim patterns
- Scaffold, Tower, FastPlace and FastBreak
- FastEat, FastBow, ChestStealer and ImpossibleInteract
- BadPackets, PacketTimer, Blink, PingSpoof, GroundSpoof and InvalidPosition

---

## 🌐 Optional BungeeCord Network Support

VRX AntiCheat is fully usable as a standalone anti-cheat plugin on a single Paper/Spigot server.

If you want to use VRX AntiCheat on a BungeeCord network, you can extend it with the optional **VRX AntiCheat BungeeBridge Addon**.

The BungeeBridge Addon allows anti-cheat alerts to be forwarded globally across your Minecraft network, so staff members can receive alerts from all connected servers in one place.

You can purchase the BungeeBridge Addon here:  
https://www.veronix-plugins.de/shop.html

Supported network features include:

- Global staff alerts
- Server name in alerts
- Signed plugin messages
- Configurable bridge channel
- Alert history and diagnostics
- Optional Redis support for larger networks

> **Note:** The anti-cheat checks run on the Paper/Spigot servers.  
> The BungeeBridge Addon only handles network-wide alert forwarding and staff notifications.

---

## 🛠️ Staff Tools

VRX AntiCheat provides useful commands for server teams, including:

```text
/ac alerts
/ac gui
/ac status
/ac info <player>
/ac verbose <player>
/ac history <player>
/ac export <player>
/ac freeze <player>
/ac exempt <player>
/ac testmode on
/ac simulate <check> <player>
/ac selfcheck
